(async()=>{window.__enableFootDebug=true; window.__pickupId='POST_OFFICE_BAY:post-office-scalesia-villosa-wash-bank'; api.openExamineSpecimen(window.__pickupId); if(!api.saveExamineNote('Noted the hairs on the leaves.')) throw new Error('Could not study the specimen'); api.closeExamine(); api.teleportNear(window.__pickupId,{distance:1.12,angle:0}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1800)); const settled=await api.waitForSettled(6000); if(!settled) throw new Error('Darwin did not settle at the specimen'); api.setCameraYaw(-1.60); return settled;})()

(async()=>{const wait=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const start=performance.now(); window.__pickupBeats={}; const observe=async()=>{while(performance.now()-start<3800){await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame); const state=api.store('collectedSpecimenActorIds','examineSession'); const now=performance.now(); const time=now-start; const motion=api.getMotionState(); if(!window.__pickupBeats.contact&&state.collectedSpecimenActorIds.includes(window.__pickupId)) window.__pickupBeats.contact={time,action:motion.action}; if(state.examineSession?.captureOutcome?.collectedActorId===window.__pickupId){window.__pickupBeats.label={time,recovered:!motion.reach||now/1000>=motion.reach.releaseAt}; api.storeAction('setExamineLabelOpen',false); return;}}}; const [record]=await Promise.all([api.recordMotion([{at:680,down:['interact']},{at:820,up:['interact']},{at:3750,down:['right']},{at:4250,up:['right']}],{durationMs:4700}),wait(230).then(()=>api.walk(0,-.25,600)),observe()]); window.__pickupReview=record.samples; return window.__pickupBeats;})()
